TOKEN=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/tmp/owner_at.json'))['token'])" 2>/dev/null)

# Commit each file to GitHub via the API
# Start with the smaller files first
echo "=== Committing files to GitHub ==="

# Function to commit a file
commit_file() {
  local path="$1"
  local message="$2"
  local content_b64=$(base64 -w 0 < "$path")
  
  local result=$(python3 << PYEOF
import json, urllib.request, sys

token = "$TOKEN"
path = "$path"
message = "$message"
content_b64 = "$content_b64"

payload = json.dumps({
    "action": "github_commit_file",
    "input": {
        "path": path,
        "content": content_b64,
        "contentEncoding": "base64",
        "message": message
    },
    "confirm": True,
    "confirmText": "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"
}).encode()

req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=payload,
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
)
try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
    data = json.loads(resp.read())
    r = data.get("result", {}).get("result", data.get("result", {}))
    if isinstance(r, dict):
        sha = r.get("sha", r.get("commitSha", "?"))
        ok = r.get("ok", "?")
        print(f"  sha={sha[:12]} ok={ok}")
    else:
        print(f"  Result: {str(data)[:200]}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body = e.read().decode()[:200]
    print(f"  ERROR {e.code}: {body}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  ERROR: {str(e)[:200]}")
PYEOF
)
  echo "  $path: $result"
}
